title: Coaching his young drummer Pete Morgan
summary: Hawkins taught the rock drummer a straight beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: The drummer, the boy I have here now. He came up at 19. He was 19. I knew his parents. All he could play was Rock and Roll. But, what happened, I said, 'Now you've got to play something different. You have to play what I want you to play now.' He said, 'I can't play it.' I said you can play it. We was playing a cocktail party. I said get up and I'll show you what I mean. I had the rest of the group to play and you just do this. You know, I told him about keeping a straight beat. A straight beat. Now, you can't find a very good drummer. He can play practically anything. And, he hadn't

played with nobody but me since he got up there. All he could do was rock. You know? But now, he can do jazz drummer. He went to Jo Jones. Jo Jones George Owens. George gave him some lessons since while he was up there with me cause he's like that. And, I sit down every now and then in the lounge now and play something. You know, cause I feel, you know, and I'll say oh, let me play something. And, sit down and play awhile.
